opportunities.name: Company account brief (SEC EDGAR 10-K + Wikipedia + email)
opportunities.description: For a given stock ticker, find the latest 10-K filing date on SEC EDGAR full-text search, look up the company's HQ, employee count and CEO on Wikipedia, and draft an 'Account brief' email to a recipient.
opportunities.site: efts.sec.gov / EDGAR full-text search, en.wikipedia.org, mail client
steps: Open EDGAR advanced search and clear the company field
Type the ticker and pick the matching company from autocomplete
Click Search, open the 'Form' refinement and select '10-K Annual report'
Note the most recent 10-K filed date
On Wikipedia, search the company name and open the company article
Read HQ, number of employees and CEO from the infobox
Open a new message: To = recipient, Subject = 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Body = '<Company>: HQ <city>, <employees> employees, CEO <name>. Latest 10-K filed <date>.'
Send (the recording discards the draft)

instances.values: SNOW / Snowflake, to dana@example.com, 10-K 2026-03-20, HQ Menlo Park, 9,060 employees, CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy
DDOG / Datadog, to dana@example.com, 10-K 2026-02-18, HQ New York City, 8,100 employees, CEO Olivier Pomel
HUBS / HubSpot: only the EDGAR 10-K filter step was recorded; no Wikipedia or email step followed

opportunities.name: Supplier quote comparison (Xe currency conversion + supplier local time + procurement email)
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier quotes in different currencies to USD on Xe, pick the cheaper one, look up the current local time in the supplier's city on timeanddate, and email the result to procurement.
opportunities.site: xe.com currency converter, timeanddate.com world clock, mail client
steps: Open the Xe currency converter (Convert tab)
Set the from-currency to the first quote's currency and the to-currency to USD
Select the amount field and type the first quote amount; note the USD value
Change the from-currency to the second quote's currency via search and type the second amount; note the USD value
Pick whichever quote is cheaper in USD
On timeanddate World Clock, search the supplier city and open its page; note the local time and timezone
Open a new message: To = procurement@example.com, Subject = 'Quotes: <item>'
Body = '<amt1> <cur1> = <usd1> USD, <amt2> <cur2> = <usd2> USD, cheaper: <cur>. Supplier time in <city>: <time> <tz>.'
Send (the recording discards the draft)

instances.values: 12500 EUR vs 1950000 JPY, Osaka, 'CNC enclosures', to procurement@example.com
8200 GBP vs 780000 INR, Pune, 'Shipping boxes', to procurement@example.com
Incomplete. A 50 INR entry and a 'CH' currency search, then a break for other work; resumed with 64000 INR → CNY and 14500 CNY. No city lookup or email was recorded

opportunities.name: Cross-office meeting sync note (time difference + holidays + ops email)
opportunities.description: Use the timeanddate Time Zone Converter to get the time difference between two cities, check the second country's holidays for the target month, and email ops a 'Sync' note listing the dates to avoid.
opportunities.site: timeanddate.com (Time Zone Converter, Holidays), mail client
steps: Go to Time Zones > Time Zone Converter (close the restore prompt if it appears)
Add city A from the location search
Add city B and note how many hours ahead it is
Go to Calendar > Holidays and pick the country for city B
Open that country's holidays for the target month and note the holiday dates
Open a new message: To = ops@example.com, Subject = 'Sync: <City A> / <City B>, <Month>'
Body = '<City B> is <offset> ahead from <City A>. Avoid: <date1> and <date2>.'
Send (the recording discards the draft)

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore (India), October, avoid Oct 2 and Oct 20, to ops@example.com
New York / Berlin (Germany), December, avoid Dec 25 and Dec 26, to ops@example.com
